## Bio

I am Xinyu Zhang*, linguist in training. I am currently a PhD candidate at [CLS Radboud](https://www.ru.nl/cls/) and [International Max Planck Research School for language sciences](https://www.mpi.nl/department/imprs-graduate-school/13/people). 

For my PhD project, I study the relationship between speech production and speech perception, by looking at both typical and clinical populations.

Previously I studied at [ACLC](https://aclc.uva.nl/about/about-aclc-update.html) of [University of Amsterdam](https://https://www.uva.nl/en), under the supervision of [Dr. Rob van Son](https://www.fon.hum.uva.nl/rob/) and [Dr. Paul Boersma](https://www.fon.hum.uva.nl/paul/).

My previous research projects include a study on the cross-generation auditory dispersion of the Dutch sibilants /s/ and /ɕ/, and a study of the psychoacoustics of perceived voice qualities after the treatment of laryngeal carcinoma.

Please like and subscribe :)

*Prescribed pronunciation: [ɕin˥˥ɥy˨˩˦ ʈ͡ʂɑŋ˥˥], but I welcome and am interested in all phonological adaptations.

## News

- Three of my blog posts are now out on Max Planck Institute's [TalkLing](https://www.mpi.nl/talkling). 
Go have a look if you are interested in some ELI5 about  the role of somatosensory feedback on speech perception, a.k.a. [Listening with your mouth full](https://www.mpi.nl/blog/listening-your-mouth-full-role-somatosensory-feedback-speech-perception), the role of auditory feedback on speech production, in other words ["Are you even listening to yourself?"](https://www.mpi.nl/blog/are-you-even-listening-yourself-role-auditory-feedback-speech-production), and/or how somatosensory information improves speech intelligibility, or to put it another way [Talk a while in their tongues](https://www.mpi.nl/blog/talk-while-their-tongues-somatosensory-information-improves-speech-intelligibility).

- I will be presenting [my production experiment](https://nvfw.org/content/2025p-accommodation-tongue-height-obstruction-acoustic-outcomes-and-aftereffects) at the [Dag van de Fonetiek](https://nvfw.org/) on 31 Oct.

- I will be presenting at Max Planck Institute's [Bite-Sized Insights](https://www.ru.nl/en/donders-institute/agenda/bite-sized-insights-mpi) on 7 Oct. Come see me during your lunch break :) 

- I was presenting at [ISSP](https://issp24.sciencesconf.org/) in Autrans, France, and had a blast!
